race.comment: EXPRESS PAYMENT (7) is an ultra-reliable galloper who added to a long sequence of top two finishes when beaten a neck by ANEMACORE over 1400m at Eagle Farm last start. Brave in defeat in open company two back over the mile which is his preferred trip. Great chance to turn the tables. ANEMACORE (1) is the obvious threat after closing too well at the Farm a fortnight ago to grab a well-deserved victory. The extra trip holds no fears so although getting up to 61kgs he is a genuine chance at going back-to-back. WARBY (8) has finished a couple of lengths shy of his chief rivals today in recent outings. Testing the patience but he is classy when right and can bob up without surprising. CUNNAMULLA FELLA (10) won a BM85 here at this distance last start to end a run of outs. In the money at six of seven over the Doomben mile so with 52.5kgs he has solid credentials.
